(i) there are Pareto-efficient rules that are Nash-implementable; (ii) any such rule is Nash-implementable through some simple mechanism; and (iii) neither completeness nor transitive-ness of the preferences over outcomes is required to achieve Nash-implementation of Pareto-efficient rules.
